title: Polylogarithmic Bounds for Nested Cycles without Geometric Crossings
summary: A problem of Erdős asks for extremal conditions forcing edge-disjoint cycles with a prescribed nested structure. In the geometric version, the nesting is required to be noncrossing with respect to the cyclic orders. Fernández, Kim, Kim and Liu proved that constant average degree forces two such cycles. We prove a polylogarithmic bound for the natural multi-layer version: for every fixed $k\ge 3$, every sufficiently large $n$-vertex graph with at least \[ C_k n(\log n)^{k-1}(\log\log n)^{k-3} \] edges contains $k$ pairwise edge-disjoint nested cycles without geometric crossings.
